The pay is a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 28,000/- plus HRA as admissible, and candidates need a Four-year Nursing Course (B.Sc. Nursing). content_sections.heading: About AIIMS New Delhi Project Nurse-III
content_sections.text: The All India Institute of Medical Sciences, New Delhi, is a medical institute. These posts are with its Department of Plastic, Reconstructive & Burns Surgery in the Burns & Plastic Surgery Block, for the department's Centre of Excellence under the National Programme for Prevention & Management of Trauma & Burn Injuries (NPPMT&BI). The notice is signed by Dr. Maneesh Singhal, Professor & Head and Project Investigator. AIIMS is also sending the notice to ten medical colleges and universities in New Delhi, including Vardhaman Mahavir Medical College and Safdarjung Hospital, Maulana Azad Medical College and the University of Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The experience in Teaching & Training Coordination is desirable, not essential. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS New Delhi Project Nurse-III
content_sections.text: AIIMS New Delhi has not asked for a postal or email application. Instead, interested and eligible candidates fill in a Google form with their brief information. AIIMS will use this information to shortlist candidates. Open the Google form at https://forms.gle/TwozPiKNcqLpuWvt6, or scan the QR code printed in the notice. Fill in your brief information in the form. Submit the form by 5.30 pm on 27 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: AIIMS New Delhi will shortlist candidates using the information they give in the Google form. Shortlisted candidates will then be interviewed, either offline or online. AIIMS will email the interview details to shortlisted candidates only, so use an email address that you check regularly.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Nurse-III vacancies are there at AIIMS New Delhi?
faq.answer: There are 2 Project Nurse-III posts. They are in the Department of Plastic, Reconstructive & Burns Surgery, AIIMS New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS New Delhi Project Nurse-III?
faq.answer: Fill in the Google form by 5.30 pm on 27 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for Project Nurse-III at AIIMS New Delhi?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a Four-year Nursing Course (B.Sc. Nursing). Two years' experience in Teaching & Training Coordination is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for AIIMS New Delhi Project Nurse-III?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years, with relaxation as per AIIMS/ICMR rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Project Nurse-III at AIIMS New Delhi?
faq.answer: The post pays a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 28,000/- plus HRA as admissible.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs. 28,000/- remuneration?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice gives the pay as Rs. 28,000/- + HRA as admissible.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for AIIMS New Delhi Project Nurse-III?
faq.answer: Fill in your brief information in the Google form at https://forms.gle/TwozPiKNcqLpuWvt6, or reach the form by scanning the QR code in the notice, by 5.30 pm on 27 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for AIIMS New Delhi Project Nurse-III?
faq.answer: AIIMS will shortlist candidates using their Google form information. Shortlisted candidates will then be interviewed offline or online, and the interview details will be sent to them by email only.

faq.question: Q9. Is the AIIMS New Delhi Project Nurse-III job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is on contract in the NPPMT&BI Centre of Excellence, and the project runs till 31/03/2027.
